Disputed by multiple parties including the patch author (Red Hat security). The rocker network device model is outside QEMU's supported security boundary. A fix patch was submitted but intentionally never merged because the CVE itself is disputed and the NULL dereference cannot occur in practice (g_new0 aborts on allocation failure).
Disputed upstream. Same as CVE-2019-12928: the QMP guest_exec command is part of the trusted administrative QMP interface not intended for unprivileged users.

Disputed upstream. The QMP (QEMU Machine Protocol) interface is a trusted administrative interface not intended for unprivileged users. Exposing QMP to untrusted users is a configuration error, not a QEMU vulnerability.
Disputed upstream as not exploitable. The alleged integer overflow in QGA command argument length checks was reviewed on the QEMU mailing list and concluded to not be a real vulnerability.
